description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseRAGIngestion' for handling Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) data ingestion, including methods for uploading files, performing OCR, chunking text, generating embeddings, and storing data in vector stores. It is intended to be subclassed by provider-specific implementations.

classes.name: BaseRAGIngestion
classes.description: An abstract base class for RAG ingestion workflows, providing methods for file upload, OCR, chunking, embedding, and storage, meant to be extended by provider-specific classes.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Prepares or fetches a file for ingestion, supporting direct data, URL fetching, or existing file ID.

methods.name: ocr
methods.description: Performs OCR on file content to extract text, using configured OCR model and optional routing.

methods.name: chunk
methods.description: Splits text into chunks using RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter based on strategy settings.

methods.name: embed
methods.description: Generates embeddings for text chunks using configured model and optional routing.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Abstract method to store data in a vector store, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Executes the full ingestion pipeline: upload, OCR, chunking, embedding, and storage, returning a response object.
